description: Which institutions hold one ticker, and which way they moved. Returns {ticker, holders, total_holders, as_of_quarter, coverage}. `holders`: the first `limit` (default 25, max 100) of the top 100 by value; `total_holders` is the TRUE filer count. Each holder carries fund_name, fund_cik, shares, value_usd (whole USD), quarter, change_type and pct_change vs that fund's prior quarter. Check `coverage.basis` ('universe' vs 'top_display') before quoting an aggregate. Common stock only; quarters can differ per row. Rows are CUSIP-resolved: a resolution failure drops or mis-attributes a row. Direction-only view: ol_ownership_changes; fund-keyed inverse: get_13f_holdings. Source: SEC EDGAR 13F-HR, ~45-day quarterly delay.

limit.description: Holders to return from the top-100-by-value page (default 25, max 100); total_holders and coverage are unchanged.
